messages:
nina: Quick heads-up: were rolling out a new dedicated inference GPU class in APAC-SG next week: mi450 (48GB, mixed-precision optimized). Target region window starts Thu May 12 02:00 UTC.

nina: Purpose: lower tail latency for long-context inference workloads. Pools: `mi450-sg-primary` and `mi450-sg-burst`.

josh: Sequence? zones?

keiko: Staggered by AZ to align with partner previews: sg-1a -> sg-1c -> sg-1b. Initial targets ~18 nodes/zone, +12 burst.

sre-bot: NOTICE: No tenant VM downtime expected; rolling infra updates only. Observability debug flags for first 72h.

leo: This is inference-only capacity. Block training workloads via a soft quota deny during rollout.

keiko: Routing: default preference for new requests to mi450 when available. Customers with hard pins remain on their pools unless they opt in.

josh: Pricing?

finance-bot: mi450-dedicated will use a preview rate. Final pricing after partner preview. If existing reserved customers switch, well prorate.

support-bot: Support playbook drafted. Tag infra tickets `mi450-rollout`. Escalation path: @keiko -> @josh -> platform on-call. Canned customer responses ready.

keiko: Telemetry to watch: per-model latency P50/P95, GPU mem headroom, KV-cache hit rate, and early preemption signals. Enabling 10% request trace sampler.

nina: Partner preview: Wed May 11 20:00-23:00 UTC in sg-1a for 3 partners. If green, full rollout to sg-1a starts May 12 02:00 UTC.

leo: Ops: tag preview nodes `mi450-preview` for quick rollback.

josh: Migration snippets (internal docs):

```
rwctl pools list --region apac-sg --filter gpu=mi450
rwctl reservations migrate --from-pool legacy-sg --to-pool mi450-sg-primary --customer <id>
```

keiko: Please avoid scheduling infra-heavy releases that depend on dedicated pools in APAC-SG during the rollout.

sre-bot: SCHEDULED: mi450 APAC-SG rollout starting 2042012800. Maintenance window per zone ends 2042099199.

josh: Ill coordinate partner comms with Sales.

keiko: Post-rollout: Ill publish token-level P95 and cost-per-token comparisons.

leo: Will follow up with quota changes and block rules.

nina: Ill publish a customer-facing announcement when sg-1a is live and share a whitelist for early access if teams need it. Ping me for partner lists.
